reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and has already given this month, A gives me more reason to believe it will work this time: $11,000 in written business pledges on top of the bank's money, quarterly spending reports at the library, and candor about the roof estimate and film release timing. B omits those and instead points out that the town must give $13,000 more than it managed last time, which makes me doubt it will succeed.
